I've written the factual map of the agent system: [map.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/system-map/map.md). It covers 29 systems, a table of who starts which agent with code line numbers (2,879 agents spawned since 2026-09-22), and every hook and timer. It's committed as `7fc3157e9`, task folder only.

- **Skills:** 20 of the 33 are working (loaded in the last 7 days), 7 are unverifiable and 6 are stale. `make`, `log-assistant` and `fork-claude-session` show no loads in any log. Scripts did the counting from three logs: the session transcripts, the hook's skill log and Servex's own log.
- **Docs that don't match the code:** 107 file paths named in the docs don't resolve. I also checked 13 claims about behaviour by hand; the code contradicts 12, and the 13th leaves out two of the three skill logs. Most of these are in the hooks readme, `Servex/doc/skills.md` and three lines of CLAUDE.md, which I didn't edit.

Separately, the claude.ai Gmail connector needs authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before agents can use it.
